lux_zone.title: Add a constant-illuminance zone
lux_zone.description: One entry per zone. Afterwards you control the zone through the virtual light this integration creates: ON = closed-loop constant illuminance, setting a brightness = manual passthrough. The real light is driven automatically.

data_description.zone_name: Zone name only (e.g. Bathroom) — it becomes the device name.
data_description.light_entity: The real dimmable light to drive.
data_description.lux_entity: Sensor that measures the light (illuminance device class preferred).

lux_reconfigure.title: Reconfigure zone
lux_reconfigure.description: Re-bind the dimmable light and illuminance sensor, or rename the zone. The runtime reloads with the new binding. Re-binding clears the calibration curve — run calibration again afterwards.

data_description.light_entity: The real dimmable light to drive.
data_description.lux_entity: Sensor that measures the light (illuminance device class preferred).

time_details.title: Time anchors
time_details.description: Fixed-time fields apply when an anchor mode is fixed; the offset applies to sunset/sunrise modes (unused fields are ignored). Transition duration 0 = instant switch.

data.sun_entity: Sun entity (default: built-in sun.sun; custom entities need next_rising / next_setting attributes)
data.end_transition: Night end transition duration (minutes, 0 = off; only applies when daytime mode is enabled)

data.day_enabled: Apply daytime settings after night ends
data.turn_on_listen: Apply settings when a light turns on
data.only_when_on: Only adjust lights that are already on

data_description.day_ci_enabled: When enabled, daytime brightness and color temperature are handed to the constant-illuminance closed loop: turning a light on during the day (or a trigger landing in daytime) switches on the selected virtual light, and the night-start anchor switches it off again to hand the light back. Daytime parameters and per-light daytime overrides have no effect while enabled (values are kept).
data_description.day_ci_virtual_light: Pick the virtual constant-illuminance light provided by the constant-illuminance feature (a light entity of the fumiha_lighting integration).
data_description.respect_manual: While a transition is running, a light you adjusted manually is left alone for the rest of that band; it rejoins the schedule at the next anchor or when turned off and on again.

anl_user.title: Night-light group
anl_user.description: Pick the lights this group controls. Per-light overrides and extra periods are configured later on the Night Light page.

anl_reconfigure.title: Night-light group
anl_reconfigure.description: Pick the lights this group controls. Per-light overrides and extra periods are configured later on the Night Light page.

lux_init.title: Closed-loop control
lux_init.description: Behavior while the light is on. Adjust the target on the 'target illuminance' number entity.

data.auto_turn_off: Auto turn off when ambient meets target

data_description.scan_interval_s: Closed-loop re-evaluation period while the light is on.
data_description.deadband_pct: Adjustments smaller than this are skipped to avoid flicker.
data_description.min_brightness_pct: Lower bound for computed brightness; guards the unstable low-end LED region.
data_description.auto_turn_off: Turn the light off after two consecutive cycles with ambient at or above target.

data_description.calibrate_step_pct: Sweep step during calibration (5 = fine, 10 = coarse; auto-upgrades to 10 after repeated timeouts).
data_description.manual_slope: Fallback linear curve (added lux per 1% brightness) when no calibration has been run; 0 disables.

anl_init.title: Time anchors
anl_init.description: Fixed-time fields apply when an anchor mode is fixed; the offset applies to sunset/sunrise modes (unused fields are ignored). Transition duration 0 = instant switch. Lights are changed via reconfigure (unique id is bound to the light set).

data.sun_entity: Sun entity (default: built-in sun.sun; custom entities need next_rising / next_setting attributes)
data.end_transition: Night end transition duration (minutes, 0 = off; only applies when daytime mode is enabled)

error.day_ci_needs_virtual_light: Constant-brightness mode needs a virtual light entity; clear the toggle or pick one.

calibrate.name: Start calibration
calibrate.description: Run the automatic curve calibration sweep: the light steps 0→100% and back, about 15-40 minutes total (up to nearly an hour when sensor updates lag) — stay out of the bathroom while it runs. Only one zone per bathroom can calibrate at a time: without a target the first calibratable zone starts (others are skipped and logged); with a target the call raises when it matches no zone or is blocked by the calibration mutex.

trigger_now.name: Trigger now
trigger_now.description: Re-anchor every night-light group now: clear manual overrides and re-apply the current band's parameters. For groups with daytime constant-illuminance coupling enabled, a daytime trigger ensures the virtual lux light is on instead of direct control (skipped when every light in the group is off and only-when-on is set).
